verificationNote: REQUIRED_HUMAN_STEP — this fixture holds ONE complete Alberta ordinary-Employee PDOC gross-to-net example that becomes the primary red test for 3B-5B-2. Founder / a Payroll operator must run each scenario through PDOC (or reference an explicit T4127/T4032 worked example) and paste the expected results below. Never derive expected values from Spectre code — that would be circular per §13. The `cases[]` include the FULL input shape and the expected result shape; expected numeric fields are marked SOURCE_PENDING_PDOC_TRANSCRIPTION until PDOC output is captured.
howToTranscribe: 1. Open PDOC at the URL above.
2. Select the pay-period date from the case's `inputs.payDate` (H1 → any Jan 1 – Jun 30 2026 date; H2 → any Jul 1 – Dec 31 2026 date).
6. Enter TD1 federal claim from `inputs.tdCredits.federalClaim` and TD1AB from `inputs.tdCredits.provincialClaim`.
7. Enter YTD figures if the case supplies `inputs.priorYtd`.
8. Read PDOC's calculated CPP, CPP2, EI, federal tax, Alberta tax, net pay values.
9. Paste them into the case's `expected.*` fields verbatim.

cases.description: Basic ordinary Alberta hourly Employee, biweekly, mid-year 2026 H1, no prior YTD, default TD1 (federal BPA + Alberta BPA only), no additional tax.
Alberta Employee with a NON-BPA-only TD1 claim (higher federal TCP + higher Alberta TCP).

Alberta Employee with `additionalFederalTaxAmount = 50.00` and `additionalProvincialTaxAmount = 25.00`. Proves the additional-tax amounts are added AFTER `T4` / `T4Prov`, never modifying the formula base.

expected.notes: Additional-tax amounts must appear as a delta over the corresponding baseline scenario `pdoc-basic-hourly-biweekly-alberta-h1` — proof of the 'added after formula' contract.

cases.description: Alberta Employee with `claimZeroFederal = true` (i.e. more-than-one-employer TD1 checkbox). Federal claim = 0 → no BPA credit.

expected.notes: Federal withholding should be materially higher than the baseline (no BPA credit applied).
